title: Coding Agent Orchestrator coordination input
description: A bounded coding objective and deterministic .CAO state transition for an explicitly activated Coding Agent Orchestrator (CAO) workflow.

activation.description: How the current user explicitly selected Coding Agent Orchestrator, including a leading uppercase CAO invocation, or that this is a continuation of an already active workflow. This field does not itself grant activation.

objective.description: The complete bounded coding outcome for the parent Codex task to own and integrate.

workspaceRoot.description: The resolved jobsite root for source inspection, scoped implementation, and acceptance.

stateTransition.description: Whether the host preserves a related workflow or initializes clearly unrelated work. The host determines this from current state and the user objective.

taskId.description: Existing or newly selected task identity recorded in .CAO/task.md.

epoch.description: Existing or newly selected workflow epoch recorded in .CAO/task.md.

requestedScope.description: User-declared source or artifact boundaries when the objective names them.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Known completion conditions that must be integrated before the first acceptance candidate.

constraints.description: Known execution, authority, safety, delivery-mode, or external-effect constraints for this objective.
